scope: Worker-published task-bound startup identity and exact OS termination reconciliation when live coordinator observation was missed; native compatibility checks and nine actual CPU lifecycle/proof/replay stages. No production ABI or proof-format change.

implementation.record: Optional immutable worker-start file, LVWST001, complete execution-bound Token plus boot/invocation/PID/start ticks/cgroup/dev/inode; bounded cgroup and total bytes.
implementation.publication: Current process checks exact service, image, argv, boot, PID birth, cgroup and pidfd before publishing. Happens before WorkerGate entry, Rayon, spill allocation or proving; failed publication prevents proving.
implementation.validation: Token, spec digest, pinned image and task dev/inode must match. Missing file yields None, not stop authority. Rejects directory copy, substitution, unsafe files, extra/truncated data and incomplete hard-linked publication.
implementation.observation: Live kernel observation first; validated durable record is fallback only when no live process is observable. Persisted identity continues to use existing observation journal.
implementation.race_fix: Final revision reproduces the temporary nlink=2 publication window while the worker is live, rejects the durable file in that window, and successfully captures/persists the live kernel identity.
implementation.stop_authority: Revoke, check exact kernel process and cgroup termination, acquire idle launch gate and persist stop receipt. Startup record, helper exit, absent service and elapsed time are not stop receipts.
implementation.limits: No-identity delayed launches and partial publication remain quarantined without authoritative live observation. Record grants no verifier-drain or proof-validity authority.
implementation.trust_boundary: Trusted local runtime with exclusive service namespace; not authentication against hostile same-UID software.
implementation.compatibility: Existing launch-token, task/spec, snapshot, proof, default verifier and production ABI encodings unchanged; new optional local task file only.

checks: Bounded worker-start codec exact token/identity and malformed/truncated rejection
Copied task, pinned-image/spec/token substitution and unsafe startup files
Six abrupt worker-start atomic publication boundaries; synthetic identities never grant release
Existing unknown-dispatch quarantine and eleven selected pinned CPU checks
Worker build; narrow/default/all-feature/all-target compatibility checks; formatting, whitespace and archived-source comparison
native_validation.limits: Offline, exclusive frozen harness, build jobs1, Rayon8, GPU disabled, RAM3GiB/no swap.
native_validation.memory_peak_note: Rounded terminal systemd report, not an exact byte measurement.

proof.exclusions: Timing excludes fixture loading, initial admission and task/launch publication; neither full64 nor complete post-seal finalization.
proof.performance_claim: None: recovery correctness, not matched optimization.

worker_accounting.source: proof/worker-journal.jsonl; invocation matches persisted identity and live snapshot

live_trial.scratch_note: Free-space gate and internal spill ceiling, not a physical filesystem quota.
live_trial.controller_accounting_note: Controller memory and CPU figures are not worker accounting.

prior_attempts.scope: Prior revision before live-kernel-first ordering fix; preserved but not final-source validation or a matched performance control.

security.fixed_parameters: Cubic Goldilocks X^3-X-1; q128; blowup16; cap6; four random codewords; PoW16; one AIR; fresh CSPRNG and strict CPU single-zero-terminal verification.
security.aggregation: Public-proof-only; no aggregator wallet witnesses, individual proofs in blocks, curve/SNARK wraps, weakened parameters or multiple roots.
security.backend: Zig frontend with approved Plonky3 backend exception.

remaining: Same-boot delayed dispatch without durable identity and partial-startup publication liveness; retain quarantine absent authoritative stop evidence.
Concurrent verifier drain/recovery, OOM/timeout and repeated lifecycle qualification.
Physical scratch enforcement and reference-aware launch/task/artifact retention.
Actual SingleWallet/Empty/Merge operation generation, arrival-driven host eligibility/reorgs, issuance and HTLC.

Profile immutable preprocessing reuse: CpuWorker creates a local ConstructionSession and clears it for every job. Cached work must remain public, identity-bound and resource-accounted, with fresh proof randomness.
GPU redundant-transfer reduction followed by at least five alternating matched comparisons; unchanged pilot not promoted.
Full64 cold<=600s and complete post-seal<=180s at12-minute cadence, one root<=2MiB and aggregate RAM48/VRAM12/scratch128GiB.
Full-tree soundness/ZK review, host integration and explicit activation.
